breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses P_cr = π²EI/(KL)² with K directly entering the effective length calculation as (KL) = 0.7 × 2000 = 1400 mm. It does not include the erroneous instruction that K 'affects only the mode shape' and instead properly applies K to the Euler buckling load formula, matching the ground truth prompt.
